speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to help me understand your condition, can you describe exactly what the sensation feels like and how long these episodes last?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; the fact that your dizziness is triggered by changes in position is a key detail. Given your age and history of hearing loss, do you notice any ringing in your ears or fluctuating hearing loss alongside these spells? REQUEST TEST: Audiometry
